what_happened: Layout 10, yellow Straw009, GlassCup023. Stage 0 at 210. Straw grasped 334-352 (width 0.013), lifted 0.60 m; navigation 352-~624. The straw was held at only ~30-45 deg from horizontal, not vertical. 776-826 it was lowered so that it lay across the cup rim (at_target 795-836, contact + centre 7 cm away). Released at 826; within ~10 steps the straw slid off the rim and lay on the counter next to the cup (end 8.7 cm, z 0.93). The arm then left; no retry.
causal_chain: straw carried tilted, near horizontal -> could not drop into the opening, rested across the rim (795-826) -> released 826 -> slid off onto the counter (836) before the gripper was 25 cm away
official_criterion_notes: Official success = straw touches the cup AND straw centre < 0.5 m horizontally from the cup centre AND gripper far; there is no 'inside' or upright test, so a straw lying across the rim or leaning on the outside of the cup would count once the gripper leaves. Near-false-positive: the official condition held 795-836 with the straw lying across the rim, not inside; only the gripper-far clause was missing. If the straw had stayed on the rim, this would have scored as a success.
